text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Keselamatan Sosial Pekerjaan Sendiri (Perbekalan) 2025.

Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2026

2. Pengeluaran sejumlah wang yang tidak melebihi empat puluh satu juta empat

ratus tujuh ribu ringgit (RM41,407,000) daripada Kumpulan Wang Keselamatan

Sosial Pekerjaan Sendiri bagi perbelanjaan untuk pentadbiran Skim Keselamatan

Sosial Pekerjaan Sendiri bagi tahun 2026 adalah dengan ini dibenarkan bagi maksud

yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Maksud Amaun

(RM)

Emolumen 4,243,000

Bekalan dan perkhidmatan 19,725,000

Pemberian, bayaran tetap dan bayaran lain 846,000

Perbelanjaan lain 1,679,000

Harta tanah, loji dan peralatan 14,914,000

JUMLAH 41,407,000

Dibuat 20 Disember 2025

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/2/27/4(13); PN(PU2)744/JLD.4]

 DATO' SRI RAMANAN RAMAKRISHNAN

 Menteri Sumber Manusia

SELF-EMPLOYMENT SOCIAL SECURITY ACT 2017

SELF-EMPLOYMENT SOCIAL SECURITY (SUPPLY) REGULATIONS 2025

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 47(1)

of the Self-Employment Social Security Act 2017 [Act 789], the Minister makes the

following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Self-Employment Social Security

(Supply) Regulations 2025.

Issue for expenditure for the year 2026

2. The issue of a sum not exceeding forty one million four hundred seven thousand

ringgit (RM41,407,000) from the Self-Employment Social Security Fund for

the expenditure on administration of the Self-Employment Social Security Scheme

for the year 2026 is hereby authorized for the purposes specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Purpose Amount

(RM)

Emoluments 4,243,000

Supplies and services 19,725,000

Grants, fixed payments and other payments 846,000

Other expenditures 1,679,000

Landed properties, plants and equipment 14,914,000

TOTAL 41,407,000

Made 20 December 2025

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/2/27/4(13); PN(PU2)744/JLD.4]

DATO' SRI RAMANAN RAMAKRISHNAN

 Minister of Human Resources
